sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety in one table; ShareLock was selected as the backup after the top tool-use RL paper was skipped from automation memory.
Main agent read the arXiv abstract, HTML full text, threat model, method, evaluation tables, adaptive defenses, ablations, failure cases, and related MCP poisoning references.
Article is pure Markdown with more than 5000 Chinese characters, no external image embeds, and evidence represented through tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid-free structured sections.
